Only Scrutiny.description: Standard route for applications requiring only document scrutiny and committee appraisal without inspection

Preliminary Scrutiny.description: Initial scrutiny of statutory documents and application completeness by Regional Officer
Preliminary Scrutiny.template: Preliminary Scrutiny completed for application {application_no}. Case advanced to Scrutiny Committee Review.

Re-Scrutiny.description: Re-scrutiny of compliance documents submitted after reversion
Re-Scrutiny.template: Re-Scrutiny completed for application {application_no}. Forwarded back to Scrutiny Committee Review.

Scrutiny Committee Review.description: Formal appraisal of application by the Regional Scrutiny Committee
Scrutiny Committee Review.template: Scrutiny Committee has appraised application {application_no} and recommended for Final Approval.

Final Approval.description: Final statutory decision and Letter of Approval (LoA) issuance by Competent Authority
Final Approval.template: Final approval granted for application {application_no}. Approval order issued.

Scrutiny+EVC.description: Comprehensive route for new programs or expansions requiring scrutiny followed by Expert Visit Committee inspection

Preliminary Scrutiny.description: Preliminary document verification prior to EVC inspection queuing
Preliminary Scrutiny.template: Preliminary scrutiny passed. Application {application_no} queued for Expert Visit Committee (EVC) scheduling.

Re-Scrutiny.description: Review of corrected documents before re-entering EVC queue
Re-Scrutiny.template: Deficiencies rectified in Re-Scrutiny for application {application_no}. Forwarded to EVC Queue.

EVC Queue.description: Awaiting allocation of inspection dates and expert committee members

EVC Inspection.description: On-site / Virtual verification of infrastructure, faculty, and labs by EVC experts
EVC Inspection.template: EVC report submitted for application {application_no}. Forwarded to Regional Committee Review.

Regional Committee Review.description: Assessment of EVC recommendations by Regional Committee
Regional Committee Review.template: Regional Committee accepted EVC findings for application {application_no} and recommended for Final Approval.

Final Approval.description: Competent Authority review and final LoA / extension issuance
Final Approval.template: Statutory approval approved by Competent Authority for application {application_no}.

EVC+SAC/SHC.description: Escalated or special cases requiring EVC followed by Standing Appellate / Hearing Committee (SAC/SHC)

EVC Queue.description: Queueing for special or compliance-related EVC inspection
EVC Queue.template: Application {application_no} queued for inspection under SAC/SHC route.

EVC Inspection.description: Physical inspection and deficiency assessment by EVC
EVC Inspection.template: EVC inspection report submitted for application {application_no}. Forwarded to SAC/SHC.

SAC/SHC Review.description: Appellate hearing before Standing Appellate / Hearing Committee
SAC/SHC Review.template: Standing Appellate Committee hearing completed for {application_no}.

Re-Scrutiny.description: Re-scrutiny of documents following SAC/SHC hearing directives
Re-Scrutiny.template: Re-scrutiny completed under SAC directives for application {application_no}.

Final Approval.description: Apex decision by Member Secretary / Chairman AICTE
Final Approval.template: Final appellate decision ratified for application {application_no}.

Only EVC.description: Direct inspection route for surprise checks, complaints, or specific infrastructure verifications

EVC Queue.template: Direct EVC inspection queued for application {application_no}.

EVC Inspection.description: Execution of inspection by expert committee
EVC Inspection.template: EVC inspection completed for application {application_no}. Forwarded for final disposition.

Re-Scrutiny.description: Re-scrutiny of compliance documents submitted post-inspection

Final Approval.description: Final officer order based directly on EVC findings
Final Approval.template: Direct EVC based approval order finalized for application {application_no}.
